section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion reports findings from two samples of Western women examining links between body appreciation, body dissatisfaction, BMI, age, and subjective happiness. The authors report that body appreciation strongly predicts subjective happiness and is negatively associated with BMI; limitations include self-selected, online samples and reliance on self-reported height and weight. The section explicitly refers to two samples but does not provide sample sizes or demographic breakdowns.
